title: Thanksgiving break with kids in Spring Branch & Memorial (2026)
description: Free and cheap things to do with kids during SBISD's Thanksgiving break, Nov 23–27: storytimes, parks, free indoor play and kids-eat-free nights.
intro: Spring Branch ISD is out all week for Thanksgiving, Monday Nov 23 through Friday Nov 27. That's five days to fill, and the trick is to plan a few anchors before the week starts: a storytime, a long park morning, a free indoor play spot for a rainy day, and an easy dinner out.

Everything here is close to home in Spring Branch and Memorial, and most of it is free. Holiday weeks change library and restaurant schedules, so check each listing before you go, especially on Thursday.
The Saturday after the break, CityCentre's Holiday in the Plaza kicks off the holiday season (the date may still change). We'll add more events to this guide as they're announced.
tips: Libraries usually close or shorten hours around Thanksgiving, and storytimes can pause on holiday weeks. Check the branch calendar the week before.
Do outdoor plans early in the week and save the free indoor spots for whichever day it rains.
Frolic's Castle at Memorial City Mall requires socks, and weekday mornings are the quietest.
Ring Library's toddler storytime opens registration about two weeks ahead, so sign up around Nov 9.
Kids-eat-free nights change without notice, especially on holiday weeks. Call the restaurant before you go.

title: Free baby & toddler storytimes in Spring Branch & Memorial: the weekly schedule
description: Every week's free library storytimes for babies, toddlers and preschoolers near Spring Branch & Memorial, plus nature walks and cabin story hours.
intro: Storytime is the easiest outing there is with a baby or toddler: it's free, it's indoors, it's under an hour, and nobody minds if your kid wanders off mid-song. Spring Branch has two library systems close together, Harris County's Spring Branch Memorial Library on Corbindale and Houston Public Library's Ring and Hillendahl branches, so there's something most weekday mornings.

Here's the week at a glance: Monday is preschool storytime with a craft at Spring Branch Memorial, Wednesday is Baby Bouncers there or toddler storytime at Ring, and Thursday is Tiny Tykes for new walkers back at Spring Branch Memorial. Outdoorsy families can add a guided Tyke Hike at the Houston Arboretum (Mondays through Nov 16) or a nature story in the log cabin at Edith L. Moore Nature Sanctuary.
Library schedules pause for holidays and change between seasons, so check each listing the week you go. We update this page whenever the libraries do.
tips: Arrive 15 minutes early. Popular storytimes hand out a limited number of free tickets, and they can run out.
Baby Bouncers and Tiny Tykes both run twice, at 10:15 and 11:15. If the first session is full or your kid naps late, aim for the second.
Ring Library's toddler storytime opens registration on the library calendar about two weeks ahead, so put a reminder in your phone.
Make a morning of it: Spring Branch Memorial Library has a playground next door, and Freed Park is a short drive from Ring Library.
It's fine to step out with a fussy baby and come back. Every storytime librarian has seen it all.
